Synopsis:
    A car deliberately drove into a group of pedestrians outside Caen train station in northern France on the evening of August 27, killing 1 and injuring 10 (7 critical, 3 serious). The driver, a Russian-born man, was arrested. No motive established yet; investigation ongoing. No known prior intelligence profile on the suspect.
